cwe_content.cwe: CWE-79,Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

candidate.Reason: Incomplete XSS sanitization - only blocks specific script and foreignobject tags but allows other XSS vectors like onclick, onload, javascript: URIs, and other event handlers that can execute malicious scripts in SVG context

Processes potentially malicious SVG content without proper sanitization, allowing XSS payloads to be returned and executed in web contexts. The 'raw' parameter bypasses any processing, directly returning unsanitized SVG
Extracts style attributes from SVG without sanitization, potentially allowing CSS-based XSS vectors or JavaScript execution through style attributes
